title: Event/Facility/Fundraising Forms

sections.heading: Requests to Use Facilities or Conduct Fundraising aboard MCB Camp Pendleton
sections.markdown:
This page is your portal for making requests to use MCCS-operated facilities or to conduct fundraising activities on base. Both activities are regulated by applicable Marine Corps and Base Orders, and all requests are subject to legal review. This form must be submitted no less than 90 days prior to the requested event.

[MCCS Facility Use & Fundraising Request](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/modules/media/?do=download&id=70d81f5c-5fbb-4b98-a5df-ff6c6b6595ce&v=1)
